english_description: Extracted from a nested archive that also bundled an Android client APK alongside this source tree. Despite the shared "Book and Sword" branding, it shares no code lineage with bxsj/bxsj1 or any other library in this collection — an entirely independent codebase, richer than a simple sect-and-map layout thanks to instanced dungeon content plus dedicated music and guild areas.
